HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeadphoneAudioEx.short_description: Equivalent sound-level intervals describing headphone playback exposure.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate.short_description: Heart rate in beats per minute: understand Apple Health readings, changing recording cadence, workout and sleep context, and common interpretation pitfalls.

typical_range.notes: Apple documents this as its optical sensor's supported range. It is not a normal resting range, a population reference interval, or a hard limit for other HealthKit sources.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateRecover.short_description: Heart-rate reduction after exercise, interpreted with the test method, workout conditions and recovery timing.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateVariabi.short_description: Beat-to-beat heart-rate variability in milliseconds, with source and recording-window context for Apple Health Recovery HRV.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRateVariabi.short_description: SDNN measures variation between normal heartbeat intervals in milliseconds. Apple Watch stores short, discrete estimates; compare source, recording duration and context before interpreting a trend.

typical_range.notes: Illustrative display span, not a validated clinical normal range or a measurement limit. Short SDNN estimates can fall outside it; recording duration and context matter.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeight.short_description: A measurement of the user's standing height, a fundamental anthropometric parameter used for health assessment, growth monitoring, and clinical calculations.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierInhalerUsage.short_description: Recorded number of inhaler puffs; medication identity and technique need separate context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierInsulinDelivery.short_description: Read insulin delivery amounts in IU, separate basal and bolus metadata, and avoid duplicate or incomplete totals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierLeanBodyMass.short_description: The total body mass minus all fat tissue, including muscle, bone, organs, and water.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierNikeFuel.short_description: NikeFuel activity points in Apple Health, with cumulative totals, historical records and source limitations.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierNumberOfAlcoholi.short_description: Recorded standard-drink equivalents in Apple Health, with source-dependent serving normalization and logging coverage.

typical_range.notes: Recorded standard-drink counts have no universal healthy range. Missing logs do not establish zero consumption.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierNumberOfTimesFal.short_description: Understand saved fall counts, Apple Watch detection coverage, recording delays and the difference between missing records and zero falls.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierOxygenSaturation.short_description: The percentage of hemoglobin in the blood that is saturated with oxygen.

typical_range.notes: Apple describes 95–100% as common wellness readings. Not a diagnostic threshold or treatment target; clinical circumstances and measurement accuracy matter.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPeakExpiratoryFl.short_description: Maximum airflow during a forceful exhalation, recorded as a volume-per-time rate.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPeripheralPerfus.short_description: Peripheral perfusion index in Apple Health, with percentage encoding, sensor-site context and interpretation limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPhysicalEffort.short_description: Estimated task metabolic intensity in METs, recorded as a discrete quantity rather than a perceived effort score.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierPushCount.short_description: Measures the number of wheelchair pushes performed by the user for mobility and exercise.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRespiratoryRate.short_description: The number of breaths taken per minute, typically measured during sleep.

typical_range.notes: MedlinePlus resting adult clinical reference; not an overnight Apple Watch target or diagnostic threshold.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRestingHeartRate.short_description: Measures the heart rate while the user is at rest and relaxed, typically the lowest heart rate during waking hours.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningGroundCon.short_description: Understand Apple Watch ground contact time, example millisecond ranges, recording intervals and pace context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningPower.short_description: Understand Apple Watch running power in watts, example ranges, workout trends and the relationship with pace and heart rate.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningSpeed.short_description: Understand Apple Health running speed, convert metres per second to pace and interpret real workout recording intervals.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningStrideLen.short_description: Understand Apple Watch running stride length per single step, with example metre ranges and speed context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierRunningVerticalO.short_description: How much your body moves up and down while running, with real Apple Health examples of ranges, recording intervals and pace context.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierSixMinuteWalkTes.short_description: A distance from a six-minute walk test or an Apple Watch estimate of expected test performance.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStairAscentSpeed.short_description: Average speed during a recorded stair-ascent interval in Apple Health.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStairDescentSpee.short_description: Average speed during a recorded stair-descent interval in Apple Health.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount.short_description: Understand Apple Health step counts, overlapping sources, daily totals and why workout records have a different cadence.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierSwimmingStrokeCo.short_description: Read swimming stroke counts in Apple Health, interval cadence, distance pairing and limits of efficiency comparisons.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierTimeInDaylight.short_description: Cumulative minutes of estimated outdoor daylight recorded by Apple Watch.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierUVExposure.short_description: UV index records in Apple Health, explaining sample duration, exposure intensity and differences from daylight time.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierUnderwaterDepth.short_description: Underwater depth in Apple Health, with units, session boundaries, sampling gaps and device limits.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierVO2Max.short_description: Maximum oxygen uptake during exercise, a key indicator of cardiorespiratory fitness.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWaistCircumferen.short_description: Apple Health waist circumference: consistent measurement technique, length units, recording frequency and waist-to-height interpretation.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingAsymmetry.short_description: Walking Asymmetry estimates the proportion of steps with different movement speeds between feet.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingDoubleSup.short_description: Walking Double Support measures the fraction of a walking interval spent with both feet on the ground.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingHeartRate.short_description: Measures the user's average heart rate while walking, providing insight into cardiovascular fitness during light activity.

typical_range.notes: Display band only; not a diagnostic reference interval or an observed example-data range.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingSpeed.short_description: Walking Speed is the average speed estimated during a recorded interval of steady walking on flat ground.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWalkingStepLengt.short_description: Walking Step Length estimates the distance between the front and back feet during steady walking on flat ground.

HKQuantityTypeIdentifierWaterTemperature.short_description: Water temperature in Apple Health, with Celsius/Fahrenheit units, session coverage and sampling nuances.
